notes: Portable 2025 public-API translation of the verified native join-time FOM ownership case. An adapter-supplied base FOM declares a publishable class and original attribute; the owner registers an instance before another federate joins with an adapter-supplied FOM module adding an attribute to that same class. The old attribute remains owned, while the new attribute is unowned for both federates; publishing the new attribute does not confer ownership. Under HLA_EVOKED, If Available acquisition leaves it unowned until Attribute Ownership Acquisition Notification arrives with the requested object, attribute set, and tag, then the joiner owns it. The four page-148 candidate fragments are treated as one ownership-state group under canonical clause 7, consistent with the native RL-309 disposition; no fragment is claimed independently complete. This does not claim arbitrary FOM merge behavior, HLA_IMMEDIATE ordering, or conformance. Official-header C++ primary/contract passed 2/2 evoked twice against current-source installed package libraries; Java parity compiles against official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime result.
